notes.title: Supermarket Times gets an OST!!
notes.content:
[b]Experience the supermarket like you never have before, with two brand new original songs!![/b]
Now playing in a Supermarket Times near you!

Shop 'til you drop to "[b]Supermarket Times Is My Bag![/b]", now serenading the first floor.

Confront the sublime ecstasy of capitalist existential dread as you hit your head against a wall to "[b]Wailing in Aisle 9[/b]", now playing on the 2nd floor!!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300116/c80f70ccb66456332853ab9036aa6569f2a885b2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300116/a4a1daa8b362f487235bea4952e01743733320d1.png[/img][/url]

"Supermarket Times Is My Bag!"
by John Young
Drums by Harpal Mudhar
Flute by Darren Sng

"Wailing in Aisle 9" 
by Filip Badiar

A big thank you to the composers and musicians who created this beautiful music!

[b]Thanks![/b]
Joel

notes.title: Abibass Trainers Update
notes.content:
Experience the new Abibass trainers!

Gameplay tweaks: some players didn't know they had a map so I've put a little reminder in. Also, I've made it easier to drag legendary keys into their legendary keyholes, the dragged detection area seemed to be too small previously.

Also, I put in a couple of hints to the legendary tasks that were a little too obtuse.

Improvements to performance too. The game may take a little longer to load up, but this should cause less stuttering(caused by loading) during gameplay.

If you experience any technical problems with the game please let me know at:  	rabbitholegames.contact@gmail.com

Thanks!
Joel
